function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to help you find the best place to order a cake—whether you’re looking for something local, a specialty shop, or just a convenient delivery option.

---

## 1️⃣ Local Bakeries & Specialty Shops  
These places often offer fresh, made‑to‑order cakes and can accommodate custom designs.

| Platform / Service | What to Look For | Tips |
|--------------------|------------------|------|
| **Google Maps / Yelp** | Search “cake shop near me” or “custom bakery” | Check recent reviews, photos, and ratings. |
| **Facebook Marketplace / Groups** | Local community groups often list nearby bakeries | Ask for recommendations from friends or neighbors. |
| **Local Food Delivery Apps** (e.g., DoorDash, Uber Eats, Postmates) | Many local bakeries partner with these apps | You can see real‑time availability and delivery windows. |

### How to Order:
1. Call or visit the bakery’s website.  
2. Specify your flavor, size, design, and delivery time.  
3. Confirm payment method (cash, card, or app).  

---

## 2️⃣ Online Delivery Platforms  
If you prefer convenience or don’t have a local bakery in mind, these platforms aggregate many vendors.

| Platform | Strengths | Typical Price Range |
|----------|-----------|---------------------|
| **DoorDash** | Huge selection, real‑time tracking | $15–$60+ depending on size & customization |
| **Uber Eats** | Fast delivery, easy app interface | $12–$55+ |
| **Postmates** | Flexible pickup/delivery options | $10–$50+ |
| **Instacart** | Grocery + bakery items; can pick up at store | $20–$70+ |
| **Amazon Fresh** | Same‑day delivery in select areas | $25–$80+ |

> **Tip:** Use filters to narrow down by “Bakery,” “Desserts,” or “Custom Cakes.” Read vendor profiles for photos and customer feedback.

---

## 3️⃣ Big‑Box Retailers & Supermarkets  
Many large grocery chains now offer online ordering and same‑day delivery.

| Store | Delivery Options | Notes |
|-------|------------------|-------|
| **Walmart Grocery** | Pickup or delivery via Walmart+, Instacart | Good for standard sizes, limited customizations |
| **Kroger** | Kroger Delivery, Instacart | Often has a “Cake Shop” section |
| **Safeway / Albertsons** | Same‑day delivery | Check for local bakery partners |
| **Whole Foods** | Amazon Prime Pantry | Premium ingredients, higher prices |

---

## 4️⃣ Specialty Cake Companies (Nationwide)  
If you’re willing to ship a cake or want a truly unique design, consider national brands.

| Company | Highlights | Shipping Policy |
|---------|------------|-----------------|
| **Goldbelly** | Curated selection from top U.S. bakeries | Ships nationwide; requires pre‑payment |
| **Bakeology** | Custom cakes delivered to your door | Free shipping within 100 miles |
| **The Cake Concierge** | Luxury custom cakes | Premium pricing, free shipping in major cities |

> **Note:** Shipping a cake can be risky unless it’s a dry cake or the company uses insulated packaging. Always confirm shipping dates and insurance.

---

## 5️⃣ DIY Ordering (Pick‑Up)  
If you’re okay with picking up, this saves delivery fees and gives you more control over freshness.

| Option | How to Order | Pros |
|--------|--------------|------|
| **Local Bakery Pickup** | Call ahead, place order, pick up at scheduled time | Avoids delivery delays, supports local business |
| **Grocery Store Pickup** | Order online, choose pickup window | Convenient, often free pickup |

---

## Quick Checklist Before Placing Your Order

1. **Flavor & Size** – Make sure the vendor offers what you want.  
2. **Customization** – If you need a specific design, confirm they can do it.  
3. **Delivery Time** – Verify the exact window and whether it’s guaranteed.  
4. **Payment Method** – Some vendors only accept cash on delivery.  
5. **Cancellation Policy** – Know how far in advance you can cancel or change.  
6. **Reviews & Photos** – Look for recent customer photos to gauge quality.  

---

### Final Thought  
If you’re ordering for a special occasion, give yourself at least 48–72 hours notice. That way you’ll get the best chance of securing the exact cake you want and ensuring it arrives on time.

Happy cake hunting! 🍰
